entities.summary: Hungary is a sovereign nation in Eastern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Budapest. Official languages include Hungarian (Magyar). Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 9.6 million. Area: 93,030 km². Comprehensive index for Hungary covering Magyar conquest (Honfoglalás ~895 CE, Carpathian Basin), Kingdom of Hungary (Saint Stephen I, crowned 1000, Christianisation), Mongol invasion 1241, Ottoman occupation (Battle of Mohács 1526, 150 years), Habsburg rule, 1848 Revolution (Kossuth), Austro-Hungarian Empire (Compromise/Ausgleich 1867), WWI, Treaty of Trianon 1920 (lost 72% territory, national trauma), Horthy regency, WWII (Holocaust, 600k Hungarian Jews murdered), 1956 Revolution (Soviet crushed), Göulásh communism (Kádár), 1989 democratic transition, EU 2004, Orbán era.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Hungary's tumultuous history has shaped its identity and influenced regional dynamics. The loss of 72% of its territory after WWI led to national trauma and a lasting impact on European politics.
